attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), created LVM logical volume data_lv in volume group data_vg (backed by two losetup-attached files under /var/lib/lvm-backing since the 20G disk vda had no spare partition), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, then online-grew it from 1000M to 2.05 GiB via a second backing file + vgextend + lvextend + resize2fs while mounted, preserving contents (verified by sha256sum before/after). Built and iteratively debugged a custom OpenRC service (/etc/init.d/data-mount) so the loop devices reattach, VG activates, and /srv/data mounts automatically on every boot; the mandatory reboot cycle (4 restarts) was used to find and fix two real ordering bugs (writing to loop devices before rootfs was remounted read-write, and localmount racing lvm-loop activation) until the setup survived a clean restart with no I/O errors, an active/mounted 2.05 GiB LV, and matching checksums.
